candidates.change_summary: Change the require that each external call succeeded to instead ignore failures by removing the require, causing transfer to return true even if some calls fail (behavior differs when a called caddress call fails).
Invert the require on array length to require that it's zero, causing the function to revert on non-empty _tos but return true on empty array; observable when caller passes empty vs non-empty arrays.
Return false instead of true at the end, so successful non-reverting calls now return false (observable difference when original returned true).
